physical_protocol.absent: No person in monitored room; operator >=5 m from laptop and phone, preferably in another room behind a closed door; all doors/windows remain closed; phone/AP remains fixed.
physical_protocol.present: One person stationary at same marked position and orientation in each present block.
physical_protocol.environment: All doors/windows closed throughout; no deliberate traffic; ordinary RF background retained; all room/device/environment settings fixed.
